content.bridge_context: Understanding how goods reach us and the different types of marketplaces.

units.title: What is a Market?
units.explanation: A place where buyers and sellers engage in the exchange of goods and services.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name the market near your house. / अपने घर के पास के बाजार का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Types of Markets
units.explanation: Weekly markets, Neighborhood shops, Shopping complexes, and Online markets.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify an online shopping app. / एक ऑनलाइन शॉपिंग ऐप की पहचान करें।
